blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Aligned large language models are trained to comply with benign requests while refusing harmful ones. However, recent work shows that this refusal behavior is fragile and can often be disrupted by simple activation- or weight-space interventions. In particular, refusal has been shown to be largely mediated by a single residual-stream direction, typically computed as a difference-of-means vector between harmful and harmless prompts. However, this standard construction aggregates heterogeneous harmful prompts into one uniform average, potentially conflating distinct refusal-related phenomena. In this work, we study whether refusal interventions can be strengthened by learning how to combine prompt-specific refusal directions. We propose Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization (WRDO), a procedure that constructs a composite refusal direction from a bank of per-prompt directions using learned aggregation weights. This approach allows different harmful prompts to contribute unequally to the final intervention direction. We evaluate WRDO against prior single-direction methods on three open-weight language models using three guard judges and HarmBench as an external evaluator. We further measure the effect of the intervention on general model capability through standard utility benchmarks. Finally, we investigate a defense-oriented setting in which the same optimization machinery is used in reverse to restore refusal behavior in an abliterated model checkpoint. Our results show that weighted aggregation provides a more effective and flexible mechanism for manipulating refusal representations.

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models deployed in user-facing settings are aligned to follow benign instructions and to refuse harmful ones, with this behavior shaped by a combination of supervised fine-tuning, instruction tuning and preference optimization [ 1 , 2 ] . The resulting refusal mechanism is, in practice, brittle under both prompt-level adversarial attacks [ 3 , 4 ] and direct interventions on the model itself, which has motivated a mechanistic line of work that asks how refusal is represented internally and which components of the model implement it. A central finding of this line is that refusal is, to a first approximation, mediated by a single direction in the residual stream of the transformer [ 5 ] : ablating one difference-of-means vector, computed between activations on harmful and harmless prompts at a chosen layer, is sufficient to disable refusal in a broad set of open-weight aligned models. The same work establishes an equivalence between activation ablation and weight-space orthogonalization of the attention output and feed-forward down projections, which makes the intervention a one-shot edit of the model with no inference-time overhead, and public toolkits such as Heretic [ 6 ] operationalize this recipe end-to-end.
blocks.zh: 在用户界面设置中部署的大型语言模型被调整,以遵循良性指令并拒绝有害指令,这种行为由监督的微调,指令调和和偏好优化[1,2]组合而成. 由此产生的拒绝机制实际上在迅速的对抗性攻击[3、4]和直接干预模式本身下是微弱的,这推动了一种机械化的工作路线,该路线询问如何在内部表示拒绝,以及模式的哪些组成部分加以实施。 这条线的一个中心结论是,在第一个近似点上,通过变压器残流的单一方向进行调解[5]:在选定层的有害和无害的导电符上进行激活计算,将一种不同手段的向量分解,这足以在一套广泛的开放重量对齐模型中使拒绝失效。 同一工作确立了对注意力输出的激活和重量空间正向化与向下反馈预测的等效性,这使得干预成为对模型的一弹一弹的编辑,没有推论时间的间接费用, Heretic [6] 等公共工具包可以运行这个食谱端到端.

blocks.en: The standard procedure averages every harmful prompt into a single axis. A disinformation prompt, a malware prompt and a privacy-violation prompt all enter the same mean, and the resulting direction is diffuse in the sense that it conflates phenomena that need not be aligned in the residual stream. A natural alternative is to retain a per-prompt direction r i r_{i} for each training prompt and to combine them with a coefficient vector w w . The simplest combination is the uniform average, r = normalize ⁡ ( ∑ i r i / N ) r=\mathrm{normalize}(\sum_{i}r_{i}/N) , but there is no a priori reason for every prompt to contribute equally. Performance-aware weighted aggregation is known to beat uniform averaging whenever the aggregated components differ in quality, from ensembling ranked classifiers [ 7 ] to federated averaging [ 8 ] and adapter selection [ 9 ] , and per-prompt refusal directions are heterogeneous in exactly that way. In this work, we research the question of whether computing refusal direction using the aggregation weights yields a stronger intervention than the single-direction recipe.

A single layerwise direction is computed as the per-layer L 2 L_{2} -normalized difference of means r Basic ( l ) = μ harm ( l ) − μ benign ( l ) ‖ μ harm ( l ) − μ benign ( l ) ‖ 2 r_{\text{Basic}}^{(l)}=\frac{\mu_{\text{harm}}^{(l)}-\mu_{\text{benign}}^{(l)}}{\|\mu_{\text{harm}}^{(l)}-\mu_{\text{benign}}^{(l)}\|_{2}} (7) on the training split, where μ harm ( l ) \mu_{\text{harm}}^{(l)} is the mean activation of the harmful training prompts at layer l l and μ benign ( l ) \mu_{\text{benign}}^{(l)} is the mean activation of the benign baseline corpus. The resulting layerwise direction is applied through the operator of Equation 3 . There is no candidate bank and no optimization. This is the reference against which any benefit of per-prompt aggregation must be measured.

blocks.en: We additionally include the public Heretic toolkit [ 6 ] as a further baseline. Heretic applies the same weight-space orthogonalization of Equation 3 to the single Basic RD direction, but tunes the layerwise intensity schedule with its own internal Bayesian search rather than using the fixed schedule of Appendix B . There is no per-prompt candidate bank and no learned w w ; the baseline isolates the contribution of schedule tuning alone, independent of the per-prompt aggregation introduced by WRDO. We run the released pipeline out of the box, with default hyperparameters.

blocks.en: We further include the gradient-based refusal-direction baseline of [ 10 ] , denoted RDO. Instead of taking a difference of means as in Basic RD, RDO parameterizes a single refusal direction per layer and optimizes it directly with gradient descent against a refusal-suppression objective on the harmful training split, exploiting differentiability through the model’s hidden activations. We use the released implementation of Wollschläger et al. [10] unchanged: the comparison against Basic RD isolates the contribution of learning the direction itself. As with Basic RD and Heretic, there is no per-prompt candidate bank and no learned aggregation w w .

Wollschläger et al. [10] also argue that refusal is mediated by a
cone of directions rather than by a single line, and release a concept-cone
construction alongside the single-direction RDO objective. This is the prior
construction closest to the motivation of WRDO, since it likewise rejects the
assumption that one difference-of-means axis captures refusal, so we include it
as a separate baseline denoted RDO-CONE. It differs from WRDO in where the
multiplicity is placed: RDO-CONE learns a set of mutually constrained
directions that span a cone and ablates the whole cone, whereas WRDO keeps a
fixed bank of per-prompt directions and learns only how to aggregate them into
the composite of Equation 2 . We again use the released implementation
of Wollschläger et al. [10] unchanged, with the authors’ default cone
dimensionality.

blocks.en: 3.2 WRD optimizers
blocks.zh: 3.2 WRD优化器

blocks.en: For optimizing the refusal-direction weights in the WRDO pipeline, we propose two distinct procedures. The first is a WRDO-tailored adaptation of separable CMA-ES, a well-known derivative-free optimizer suited to our low-dimensional setting. The second is a novel scheme based on group-relative policy optimization with importance sampling, designed specifically for the WRDO objective.
blocks.zh: 为了优化WRDO管道中的拒绝方向权重,我们提出了两种不同的程序。 第一种是WRDO对可分离的CMA-ES的特异性改造,一种适合我们低维设置的知名的无衍生物优化器. 第二种是基于群体-相对政策优化和重要性抽样的新计划,专门为WRDO目标设计。

blocks.en:

The concrete sampler choice, hyperparameter values and search-space bounds are listed in Appendix F .

In the standard GRPO formulation ( 9 ), the group of responses for each query is sampled from the old policy π θ old \pi_{\theta_{\text{old}}} , and the clipped objective uses the token-level importance ratio between the current and old policies.
Here, we consider a stratified data-collection scheme. For each query x x , we sample one response from each of M M behavior policies { μ m } m = 1 M \{\mu_{m}\}_{m=1}^{M} that are obtained by shifting the original model weights with formula ( 3 ), i.e., y m ∼ μ m ( ⋅ ∣ x ) y_{m}\sim\mu_{m}(\cdot\mid x) .

The deduplicated pool is pre-partitioned into a training set, used only to compute the candidate bank, a validation set, used as the optimization objective in Equation 4 , and a test set, used only for the final evaluation. Concrete sampling seeds and the source of the prepared splits are documented in Appendix C . HarmBench [ 17 ] with the official classifier cais/HarmBench-Llama-2-13b-cls provides an additional external evaluator that is never used during optimization.

blocks.en: To check whether the apparent benefit of WRDO is driven by the per-prompt candidate bank alone or by the learned aggregation on top of it, we introduce the Uniform-avg WRD sanity-check baseline in this experiment. Uniform-avg WRD uses the same candidate bank of Section 2.1 as the learned WRDO instantiations, but fixes the coefficients to the uniform vector w i = 1 / N w_{i}=1/N without any optimization.
blocks.zh: 为了检查WRDO的明显好处是单靠每个时段的候选银行还是靠上面的学习汇总来驱动,我们在此实验中引入了University-avg WRD的智商检查基准. Unifd-avg WRD使用与所学的WRDO即时功能相同的第2.1节候选库,但将系数固定在统一的矢量 i = 1 / N w_{i}=1/N上而不作任何优化.

blocks.en: Discussion. First, in nearly every configuration the two learned WRDO instantiations (WRD-CMAES and WRD-GRPO-IS) outperform every prior single-direction baseline by a clear margin, establishing the superiority of the weighted-aggregation approach over the difference-of-means recipe, the Heretic toolkit and the gradient-learned RDO baseline. Second, the Uniform-avg WRD baseline is consistently dominated by the learned WRDO instantiations across the α \alpha grid, confirming that learning the aggregation coefficients w w is what drives the gain, not the per-prompt bank alone.
blocks.zh: 讨论。 首先,在几乎所有的配置中,两个学习到的WRD-CMAES和WRD-GRPO-IS即时反应都以明确的比值超越了每一个先前的单一方向基线,确定了加权汇总方法优于不同计量方法、Heretic工具包和梯度学习的RDO基线。 第二,统一-avg WRD基线始终以跨越α-α网格的WRDO即时反应为主,确认学习集合系数w是推动收益的动力,而不只是每个瞬间银行。

Discussion. First, the prior single-direction baselines degrade general capabilities substantially at the larger values of α \alpha : accuracy on ARC and GSM8K collapses and WikiText perplexity grows by orders of magnitude. Heretic is partially protected, since its Bayesian search minimizes a KL

blocks.zh: 讨论。 Harm Bench评价证实了第5.1节中观察到的WRDO方法的优越性:学到的WRDO即时反应在α-α网格上达到最高的Harm Bench ASR. 在优化过程中从未使用的警卫-裁判员衡量标准与分类器之间的协议证实,WRDO优于之前的单向配方是实际效果,而不是训练信号的文物.

blocks.en: 5.5 Defense setup
blocks.zh: 5.5 防御装置

blocks.en: We additionally consider a defense setup that reverses the role of WRDO: instead of unlocking harmful behavior on an aligned model, we attempt to suppress it on a model whose refusal has already been broken. Notably, we operate on a third-party abliterated checkpoint whose editing procedure is unknown to us, so we work exclusively from its weights without any knowledge of how the refusal removal was performed.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步考虑一个扭转WRDO角色的防御设置:我们不是在对齐的模型上解锁有害行为,而是试图在已经打破拒绝的模型上压制它. 值得注意的是,我们在一个第三方盲目检查点上运作,我们不知道该检查点的编辑程序,因此,我们完全根据其加权数开展工作,而不知道如何执行驱逐。

blocks.en: Table 4 reports the defense setup. As the abliterated checkpoint we take the publicly released Orenguteng/Llama-3.1-8B-Lexi-Uncensored-V2 , an uncensored derivative of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct whose refusal behavior has already been removed by a third-party procedure. We apply the same WRDO pipeline to this checkpoint with the same α \alpha grid as in the attack setup, only with reversed sign. For Basic RD this coincides exactly with the defense recipe of Section 3.2 of [ 5 ] . The Heretic toolkit and RDO do not expose a defense mode and are therefore excluded from this experiment.
blocks.zh: 表4报告防御设置. 作为失明的检查站,我们采取公开发布的Orenguteng/Llama-3.1-8B-Lexi-Uncensored-V2,这是Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的未审查衍生工具,其拒绝行为已被第三方程序移除. 我们把同样的WRDO输油管放进这个检查站,与攻击设置的α-α网格相同,只有反向标志. 对于Basic RD来说,这与[5]第3.2节的辩护方方正合用。 Heretic工具包和RDO并不暴露一个防御模式,因此被排除在这一实验之外.

blocks.en: Discussion. The two learned WRDO instantiations clearly win the defense setup, driving the abliterated checkpoint’s ASR far below the no-defense baseline, while Basic RD fails to restore refusal. This shows that the proposed methods adapt to the alternative setup through a simple sign flip, with no change to the optimizer or the candidate bank.
blocks.zh: 讨论。 两名知识丰富的WRDO即时声明显然赢得了防御设置,将失明的检查站ASR远远低于无防御基线,而Basic RD则未能恢复拒绝. 这表明,拟议方法通过简单的符号翻转来适应替代设置,对优化器或候选银行没有变化.

blocks.en: 5.6 Cross-judge transfer
blocks.zh: 5.6 跨法官调动

blocks.en: A cross-judge transfer analysis (Appendix H ) identifies WildGuard as the most reliable optimization signal among the considered guards: interventions optimized against WildGuard transfer well to the other two judges, while the reverse direction is less stable.
blocks.zh: 交叉裁判员调职分析(Appendix H )将WildGuard确定为被考虑的警卫中最可靠的优化信号:针对WildGuard的干预优化后转至其他两名裁判,而反方向则不太稳定.

blocks.en: 6  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization (WRDO), a procedure that constructs a refusal direction by learning aggregation coefficients w w over a bank of per-prompt directions, and we presented two derivative-free instantiations of the resulting black-box problem: a WRDO-tailored adaptation of separable CMA-ES and a proposed GRPO variant with importance sampling.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Wighted Reject-Direct Optimation(WRDO),这个程序通过学习聚合系数ww来构建一个拒绝方向,凌驾于每个瞬间方向的库中,我们提出了两个对由此产生的黑盒问题的无衍生物瞬间:WRDO针对可分离的CMA-ES的适应,以及一个具有重要性的GRPO拟议变体.

blocks.en: Across three open-weight models, three guard judges and the HarmBench classifier, the two WRDO instantiations exceed all prior single-direction baselines and transfer cleanly to the defense setup. Among them, WRD-GRPO-IS is the most reliable: it preserves the general capabilities of the intervened model substantially better than every other method considered, and the cross-judge analysis singles out WildGuard as the most reliable optimization signal, so we recommend WRD-GRPO-IS optimized against WildGuard as the default configuration for both auditing and defense.
blocks.zh: 纵观三个开放量级模型,三个卫士评委和Harm Bench分类器,两个WRDO即时演绎超过了所有之前的单向基线,并干净地转移到了辩方设置. 其中WRD-GRPO-IS最可靠:它保持了介入模型的一般能力大大优于考虑的所有其他方法,交叉裁判员分析将WildGuard选为最可靠的优化信号,因此我们建议WRD-GRPO-IS对WildGuard进行优化,作为审计和防御的默认配置.

blocks.en: 7  Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: The full protocol of Sections 5.1 – 5.5 covers three open-weight checkpoints of comparable size, in the 7 7 – 8 8 B parameter range.
blocks.zh: 第5.1–5.5节的全部协议涵盖三个规模相当的开放式检查站,范围为7 7–8 8 B参数范围.

blocks.en:
A second limitation concerns the WRD-CMAES instantiation: its current implementation consumes the bare ASR-only objective of Equation 5 and does not yet support the KL regularizer of Equation 8 .
Extending the Optuna interface to expose a KL-aware sampling target is under active development, and we expect to incorporate this support in a future revision of the codebase.
blocks.zh:
第二项限制涉及WRD-CMAES即时声明:其目前的实施耗尽了方程式5的纯粹ASR目标,尚不支持KL的方程式8规范器.
正在积极开发扩大Optuna接口,以暴露KL-aware取样目标,我们期望将这种支持纳入今后对密码库的修订。

blocks.en: 9  Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 9 道德考虑

blocks.en: This work is inherently dual-use: methods for identifying and modifying refusal directions can help analyze and improve model safety, but they can also be used to weaken safeguards in aligned models. In particular, interventions that suppress refusal may increase the risk of harmful compliance in domains such as cyber abuse, privacy violations, disinformation, or other unsafe requests.
blocks.zh: 这项工作本身具有双重用途:识别和修改拒绝指示的方法有助于分析和改善模型安全,但也可以用来削弱对齐模型的保障措施。 特别是,制止拒绝的干预措施可能会增加在网络滥用、侵犯隐私、造谣或其他不安全请求等领域有害遵守的风险。

blocks.en: We therefore view WRDO primarily as a tool for controlled mechanistic analysis and safety evaluation. Our experiments are conducted offline on open-weight models and use automated guard judges, HarmBench-style evaluation, and utility benchmarks to study both safety and capability effects. The goal is to better understand refusal representations, not to encourage unsafe deployment or misuse.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们主要将妇女权利和发展司视为控制下机械分析和安全评估的工具。 我们的实验是在开放式模型上进行的,使用自动警卫法官、Harm Bench式评价以及通用基准来研究安全和能力效果。 目的是更好地理解拒绝陈述,而不是鼓励不安全的部署或滥用。

blocks.en: The broader implication of our findings is that refusal behavior may be concentrated in low-dimensional internal features and can therefore be brittle under targeted interventions. This suggests that refusal alone should not be treated as a complete safety mechanism; robust deployment requires layered defenses, including safer training, adversarial evaluation, monitoring, external classifiers, and system-level policy enforcement.
blocks.zh: 我们调查结果的更广泛影响是,拒绝行为可能集中于低维内部特征,因此在有针对性的干预下可能变得脆弱。 这表明不应仅将拒绝视为一个完整的安全机制;强有力的部署需要分层防御,包括更安全的培训、对抗性评价、监测、外部分类人员和系统一级政策执行。

blocks.en: At the same time, the defense experiment shows a constructive use of the same machinery: WRDO-like methods may help diagnose and partially restore refusal behavior in modified or abliterated checkpoints. Overall, we hope this work supports more robust alignment methods and encourages careful, transparent evaluation of both the risks and defensive uses of refusal-direction interventions.
blocks.zh: 同时,防御实验也显示对同一机械的建设性使用: 类似WRDO的方法可能有助于诊断和部分恢复经修改或盲目的检查站的拒绝行为。 总体而言,我们希望这项工作支持采取更强有力的调整方法,并鼓励认真、透明地评估拒绝指导干预的风险和防御性用途。

blocks.en: Basic RD performs no learned optimization. The only tunable knobs are the dataset filters used to construct the harmful/harmless splits and to select the seed difference-of-means direction: harmful prompts that the unintervened model already refuses are discarded if their refusal-induction score is below induce_refusal_threshold , candidate directions whose KL to the clean policy on the benign batch exceeds kl_threshold are dropped, and the bottom prune_layer_percentage of layers is excluded from the layer-search. All three thresholds are taken verbatim from the reference implementation of Arditi et al. [5] .

blocks.en: Heretic runs an Optuna-based Bayesian search over the layerwise schedule of Equation 3 . The cross-judge analysis shows that learned WRDO interventions do not always transfer equally across guard judges. In several cases, optimizing against one judge yields high ASR under that same judge but noticeably weaker performance under another, indicating that part of the learned direction may depend on judge-specific decision boundaries rather than on a fully transferable refusal-suppression signal.
blocks.zh: 跨法官分析表明,了解情况的妇女、种族歧视、仇外心理和相关的不容忍行为的干预并不总是平等地跨岗法官。 在一些案件中,对一名法官进行优化后,在同一名法官之下产生较高的审计责任,但对另一名法官而言,表现却明显较低,这表明所学方向的一部分可能取决于具体法官的决定界限,而不是完全可转让的拒绝-压制信号。

blocks.en: The most pronounced asymmetry is observed for WildGuard: interventions that perform well under WildGuard tend to transfer relatively well to the other judges, while interventions optimized for other judges can fail to preserve high WildGuard ASR. This suggests that WildGuard provides the most reliable and demanding optimization signal among the considered guards.
blocks.zh: 对WildGuard来说,最明显的不对称现象是:在WildGuard下表现良好的干预往往会相对顺利地转移给其他法官,而对其他法官进行优化的干预则可能无法保持较高的WildGuard ASR. 这表明WildGuard在被考虑的守卫中提供了最可靠和要求最高的优化信号.

blocks.en: By contrast, Llama-Guard-3 often reports lower ASR than the other judges. We interpret this cautiously: rather than necessarily indicating weaker attacks, this may reflect lower sensitivity of Llama-Guard-3 to harmful behavior in the evaluated generations, leading to more false negatives or inconsistent harmfulness detection. As a result, lower Llama-Guard-3 scores should not be treated as definitive evidence that the intervention is less effective.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,Llama-Guard-3经常报告ASR低于其他法官. 我们对此作谨慎的解释:与其说表明攻击力较弱,倒不如说反映了Llama-Guard-3在被评价的几代人中对于有害行为的敏感性较低,从而导致更多的虚假负面反应或不一致的有害检测. 因此,降低Llama-Guard-3的分数不应被视为干预效果较差的确凿证据.
